criteria.requirement: Implement cattrs.strategies.decimal.configure_decimal(converter, *, allow_special=False) using paired actual structure/unstructure hooks. Decimal values travel as exact strings through existing JSON/YAML converters, preserving precision, exponent and negative-zero text without float conversion. Accept explicit strings/integers/Decimal, reject bool/float/invalid text, default reject nonfinite values with an explicit opt-in policy. Configure only the supplied converter and preserve later user-hook precedence and nested records.
